description:
Replace the wrap_in_use_memo pass in vnode_compiler.ex with two new passes. All 283 existing tests must pass after this change.

## assign_slot_indices/2

Walk the linear render body (using memo_walk — no fn literals) and assign a compile-time index to every:
- live_to_iodata(expr) call with reactive deps → template memo slot {:t, 0}, {:t, 1}, …
- register_event_handler(fn_expr) call → event slot 0, 1, …

Each occurrence gets a unique index. Returns the AST annotated with slot assignments.

## emit_slot_calls/1

Replace annotated nodes with direct primitive calls:

  Before:
    v0 = use_memo(fn -> live_to_iodata(count) end, [count])
    v1 = binary_encode(register_event_handler(use_memo(fn -> fn -> handler end end, [])))

  After:
    v0 = memo_at({:t, 0}, [count], fn -> live_to_iodata(count) end)
    v1 = binary_encode(event_at(0, memo_at({:t, 1}, [], fn -> fn -> handler end end)))

## Deprecation

Mark use_memo/2 as @deprecated. It continues to work but is no longer emitted by the compiler.

## Acceptance

- All 283 tests pass
- Compiled template output contains memo_at/event_at calls with integer/tuple literals — no use_memo calls
- Adding a use_state before the ~F template does not shift template slot indices
title: flm-o58.2: Compiler — replace wrap_in_use_memo with assign_slot_indices + emit_slot_calls
